title.en: Beyblade X strategy notes from AI Sister discussions
title.zh: AI 教你打陀螺：Beyblade X 戰術筆記

description.en: Notes in Traditional Chinese on Beyblade X strategy, compiled from four AI Sister discussions: how scoring works, how to build a 3v3 deck, what to buy first, and how to practice.
description.zh: 從 AI Sister 上四篇 Beyblade X（戰鬥陀螺）討論整理而成的中文筆記：怎麼計分、怎麼組 3v3 牌組、先買什麼、怎麼練。

eyebrow.en: Beyblade X · Notes in Traditional Chinese
eyebrow.zh: Beyblade X · 中文戰術筆記

lede.en: Beyblade X is not just about spinning the longest. These notes turn four AI Sister discussions into a framework: learn what each finish scores, then build three tops that split the work of scoring, holding, and countering.
lede.zh: Beyblade X 不是單純比誰轉最久。這份筆記把 AI Sister 上四篇討論整理成一套框架：先搞懂每種勝利拿幾分，再讓三顆陀螺分工搶分、穩守和反制。

notes.zh: 來源：4 篇 AI Sister 文章

meta.en: Usual values in the notes; check your event's rules
meta.zh: 筆記裡的一般計分，賽前仍要確認賽制

body.en: The better question: under the current rules, how do three tops score most efficiently? A stamina top that mostly wins by Spin Finish earns 1 point at a time, so it has to win several times in a row to close a match. An attacker can change the whole match with one big finish, but it is also the most likely to knock itself out.
body.zh: 更好的問法是：在現在的規則下，怎麼用三顆陀螺把分數拿得最有效率？持久型主要靠自旋勝利，一次只拿 1 分，要連續成功好幾次才收得掉一場；攻擊型抓到一次大機會就能改變整場，但也最容易自爆。

quote.en: Don't ask which top is strongest. Ask what kind of points this top earns in your deck.
quote.zh:
不要問「哪顆最強」，
改問「這顆在我的牌組裡負責賺哪一種分數」。

intro.en: In the formal 3v3 format each player brings three different tops, and parts cannot repeat. So the notes treat a deck as a set of roles, not a ranking.
intro.zh: 3v3 正式配置要帶三顆不同的陀螺，零件不可重複。所以筆記把牌組看成分工，而不是排行榜。

body.en: Goes for Over, Burst, and Xtreme Finishes to open up the score in one hit. The risk is a self-KO, so do not go all-in when you are already ahead.
body.zh: 負責 Over Finish、Burst Finish、Xtreme Finish，一次把分差拉開。風險是自爆，比分領先時不要無腦梭哈。

body.en: Cuts down self-KOs, holds the center, and makes the opponent's attacks miss. The risk is slow scoring, since a Spin Finish is usually worth only 1 point.
body.zh: 負責減少自爆、守中心、逼對手攻擊失誤。風險是拿分慢，因為自旋勝利通常只有 1 分。

body.en: Built against what your local scene plays most, such as right-spin stamina, attackers, or Wizard Rod types. It can also take the last point safely.
body.zh: 針對當地常見牌組，例如專打右迴持久、抗攻擊，或處理 Wizard Rod 類型；也可以用來穩穩補最後 1 分。

intro.en: The notes are written in Traditional Chinese. The first four each summarize one AI Sister post; the last two are practical guides.
intro.zh: 前四篇各整理一篇 AI Sister 文章，後兩篇是實用指南。

intro.en: The notes use the usual Beyblade X rates. A match on those rates ends at 4 points, and the event can use different ones.
intro.zh: 筆記用的是 Beyblade X 常見的計分。以這個算法先到 4 分就結束，賽制本身仍可能不同。

note.en: A Spin Finish, the top that spins longer, usually scores 1 point.
note.zh: 自旋勝利是轉得比較久，通常只有 1 分。

note.en: An Over Finish, knocking the other top out, is usually 2 points.
note.zh: Over Finish 是把對手撞出場，通常是 2 分。

note.en: A Burst Finish, where the other top comes apart, is usually 2 points.
note.zh: Burst Finish 是把對手打到爆裂，通常是 2 分。

note.en: An Xtreme Finish is usually worth 3 points, the highest rate in these notes.
note.zh: Xtreme Finish 通常值 3 分，是這份筆記裡最高的分數。

note.en: Under the rates in these notes, the match ends when one side reaches 4.
note.zh: 依照筆記裡的算法，一方先到 4 分，這場就結束。

ticks.zh: 撞出和爆裂通常 2 分

ticks.en: xtreme is usually 3, then 4 ends it

caption.en: The notes treat a Beyblade X match as a score sheet, not a spin-time contest. A Spin Finish is usually 1 point, an Over Finish or a Burst Finish is usually 2, and an Xtreme Finish is usually 3. On those rates the match ends when one side reaches 4, so a stamina top that only takes spin finishes has to win several times, while one big finish can change the match. The notes say to confirm the event, including whether it really goes to 4.
caption.zh: 筆記把 Beyblade X 看成分數帳，而不是比誰轉最久。自旋勝利通常 1 分，Over Finish 或 Burst Finish 通常 2 分，Xtreme Finish 通常 3 分。以這個算法，一方先到 4 分就結束，所以只靠自旋的持久型要連贏好幾次，一次大分就能改變整場。筆記也寫明賽前要確認賽制，包括是不是真的先到 4 分。

intro.en: A formal 3v3 deck is three different tops, and parts cannot repeat. The notes split that deck into jobs instead of ranking a single top.
intro.zh: 正式 3v3 要帶三顆不同的陀螺，零件不能重複。筆記把牌組拆成三種工作，而不是替單顆排名。

note.en: You bring three different tops. Parts cannot be repeated across them.
note.zh: 上場帶三顆不同的陀螺，零件不能在三顆之間重複。

note.en: It hunts Over, Burst, and Xtreme finishes, and it is the one most likely to knock itself out.
note.zh: 它追 Over、Burst、Xtreme，也是最容易自己爆掉的一顆。

note.en: It holds the center and mostly scores by the 1-point spin finish.
note.zh: 它守住中心，拿分多半靠 1 分的自旋勝利。

note.en: It is built against the local scene, and it can also take the last point safely.
note.zh: 它針對當地常見牌組，也可以用來穩穩補最後 1 分。

caption.en: In the formal 3v3 format the notes describe, each player brings three different tops and parts cannot repeat. The point grabber goes for Over, Burst, and Xtreme finishes and can knock itself out. The anchor holds the center and mostly earns the 1-point spin finish. The counter is chosen for the local scene, such as right-spin stamina or Wizard Rod types, and it can also take the last point. The notes treat that as a split of jobs, not a ranking of one strongest top.
caption.zh: 筆記講的正式 3v3，每人帶三顆不同的陀螺，零件不能重複。搶分手追 Over、Burst、Xtreme，也可能自爆。穩守手守中心，拿分多半是 1 分的自旋勝利。反制手針對當地常見牌組，例如右迴持久或 Wizard Rod 類型，也可以穩穩補最後 1 分。筆記把這看成分工，不是替單顆排最強。

intro.en: The technique note is a loop. You drill a launch, write down what the top did, then review the match before the next session.
intro.zh: 技巧筆記是一個循環。先練一種發射，記下陀螺的結果，賽後再復盤，下一回接著練。

note.en: Practice the flat launch, the angled launch, and controlled power.
note.zh: 練平射、斜射，以及控制力道。

note.en: Record whether it stayed in the center, took the outer line, hit the wall, or burst.
note.zh: 記下它留在中心、走到外圈、撞牆，還是爆掉。

note.en: Ask whether a loss came from the launch angle, the stadium, the matchup, or the deck.
note.zh: 問這場輸在發射角度、場地、對位，還是牌組本身。

caption.en: docs/techniques.md splits practice into a flat launch for the center, an angled launch for the outer line, and power control for tops that burst easily. For the angled drill it says to record whether the top entered the X line, hit the wall, or burst. The same note's review, also in the README, asks whether a loss came from the launch angle, the stadium, the matchup, or the deck itself. The next session starts from that note.
caption.zh: docs/techniques.md 把練習分成守中心的平射、走外圈的斜射，以及給容易自爆的陀螺用的控力。斜射那段要記下它是進 X 線、撞牆，還是爆掉。同一篇的復盤，README 也寫了：輸是因為發射角度、場地、對位，還是牌組本身。下一回練習從這份紀錄接著做。
